requests.request: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter.

evaluation.summary: A truthful, well-structured English CV and letter that use the portfolio and notes thoroughly (PhD expected 2027, certification, drift monitoring, kappa) and handle real gaps such as RAG and LLM experience honestly. The cover letter ties banking complaint classification to ticket routing convincingly. The main weakness is PDF text extraction: several lines merge into run-on words, including the MLOps skills line and the lead achievement bullet, hurting ATS parsing. Minor issues are the dropped location and uneven page fill on the CV.
